design: two-patient retrospective study; patient1 development, patient2 whole-patient test
primary_endpoint: seed-mean macro foreground Dice on patient2 confirmed Z25
selection_rule: best per-epoch resized-validation foreground Dice; first checkpoint wins ties
pretraining_ablation: ResNet18 scratch versus ImageNet, both encoder BN trainable, same control loss and optimizer
frozen_bn_sensitivity: ImageNet control frozen-BN versus trainable-BN is separately available

metrics.HD95_definition: max of the two directional 95th-percentile nearest external-contour distances
metrics.empty_predictions: retained; nonfinite distances explicit, never silently excluded
metrics.mask_semantics: union of existing polygon interiors; no inversion from fluorescence color

analysis.seed_summary: mean and sample SD, not patient confidence intervals
analysis.paired_contrasts: descriptive matched-seed deltas; no frame-wise independence or patient-level p-values

limitations: Only two patients, with one independent test patient; no general-population performance claim.
Within-patient validation remains correlated; source-folder isolation does not prove temporal separation.
Prior patient1 internal test frames now belong to development in this new study only; prior results and files preserved.
Patient2 images and labels were reviewed during data intake and phase adjudication; study is retrospective, not prospectively blinded.
L versus original Z groups may differ in view, fluorescence and deformation; this is occlusion-stratified association, not causal isolation.
Original-Z images have not been certified tool-free.
External mask contours include instrument-contact and crop closure; HD95 does not isolate anatomical intersegmental boundaries.
No reliable video order/timestamps or temporal reference; no clinical dynamic-tracking claim.
Bilinear CUDA backward can be nondeterministic; fixed seeds, deterministic cuDNN, TF32 disabled; warn-only deterministic algorithms recorded.
